criterion_text: — Owner-backed Get across hosts: with one Agent/tmux Session whose persisted metadata has a known revision, invoking Get from Agent-embedded, Server-embedded and standalone (Server-routed and permitted direct-Agent configuration) reports the same actual title/description/tags/revision and instance identity. Restarting the Agent preserves that Session's metadata; a live legacy Session returns revision 0; an unavailable Agent or absent Session is not returned as an empty successful read.

verifiers.summary: Every hosting mode reads one owner-backed Session metadata record and identity

evidence.value: nession-mcp at exact SHA 2796eceb717e4508681c3a8ea21172ecf3ed7e45: one real Agent backed all four MCP hosting modes; Get returned the same revision-0 record and instance identity from each, a missing Session was not_found rather than an empty success, and the list carried the summary

verifiers.summary: The Agent owner is durable across restart and never lends metadata to a successor

evidence.value: nession-agent at exact SHA 2796eceb717e4508681c3a8ea21172ecf3ed7e45: metadata survived a fresh store over the same tmux Session, a legacy Session read revision 0 with empty fields, and a recreated same-name Session started at revision 0 with a different instance identity
